queue.cli.summary.enqueue: Queue an accepted Attempt for delivery to a target
queue.cli.summary.list: List delivery queue tickets in a scope
queue.cli.summary.confirm: Confirm the exact queued batch in the terminal
queue.cli.summary.rollback: Queue the rollback of the latest queued adoption
queue.cli.help:
deckent task integration-queue-enqueue --input <file|-> [--json]
  Input: {schemaVersion:1, commandId, identity, target}
  identity: scopeId, runId, taskId, attemptId, generation, layoutRevision
  target: {kind:"git-ref", id:"refs/heads/<branch>"}
deckent task integration-queue-list --scope <id> [--after <id>] [--limit <n>]
    [--verbose] [--json]
deckent task integration-queue-inspect --scope <id> --command-id <id> [--json]
deckent task integration-queue-confirm --scope <id> --command-id <id>
Confirmation requires the verified human terminal. Publication and adoption each show their exact batch and ask y/N.
deckent task integration-queue-rollback --scope <id>
    --source-command-id <queue-ticket> --command-id <new-id>
Then use integration-queue-confirm for the rollback ticket; one exact y/N card.
